title: 第1610章 丹增法王追来第1609章 李天陨落
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
杜明丰和郭和在殿中站了片刻，对视一眼，也各自散去。
与此同时，南洲妖市，黑水大殿。
殿门敞开着，夕阳从门外斜斜地照进来，照在众人脸上。
段正淳坐在台阶上，手里端着一杯灵茶，没有喝，目光落在殿门外。
杨镇山坐在座位上，双手抱胸，闭着眼，像在打盹，又像在想事情。
鬼手七也坐在殿侧的木椅上，没有任何表情。
何州靠在廊柱上，就这样静静看着外面。
红姑蹲在角落里，没有看任何人，也没有说话。
殿中安静了好一会儿，段正淳终于开口，声音不高不低：“半年了，少主一点消息都没有。”
杨镇山回答了一个字：“嗯。”
鬼手却没有开口。
何州看了段正淳一眼：“你是说他？”
段正淳没有回答。
“半年没有消息了。”段正淳重复着这句话，又咽了回去，“蛟玄找了三天就撤了。四大洲那边都默认他死了。”
杨镇山睁开眼，开口道：“你信吗？”
段正淳没有立刻回答。
红姑的声音从角落传来，不高不低：“他死没死，跟我们有什么关系？反正他死了，我们也翻不了身。”
她顿了顿，“他活着，我们也翻不了身。”
段正淳没有反驳。
鬼手七的声音从角落传来，不高不低：“他要是死了，我们还能活着坐在这里？”

他的话音落下后，殿中安静了片刻。
段正淳知道鬼手七说的是什么意思——精血还在，命还在，他们五个人还活着，就说明那个人还活着。
因为精血与主人的生死是绑在一起的，若主人陨落，精血便会失去感应。
他们五个人都还活着，说明那人还没有死，至少还没有彻底陨落。
何州接过话：“没死，但也可能被困住了，或者重伤在养伤。”
没有人接话。
杨镇山的声音传来，比方才低了几分：“他死没死，我们说了不算。但有一件事是确定的——他没回来，我们这几个人的日子，比他在的时候安稳多了。”
红姑从抬起头来，像是那句话说到了她心里：“是啊，他不在，没人管我们，也没人要我们拼命。这半年，倒是过得最安稳的日子。”
段正淳开口道：“他回来也好，不回来也好，跟我们都没关系了。他要是真不回来了，我们就在妖市待着，反正没地方去。他要是回来了，我们再看他需要我们做什么。”
杨镇山没有再开口。
何州也没有再说话，像是什么都没有发生过一样。
红姑重新低下头，刚才那句话像是落在众人心里。
——
与此同时，西洲西北部，密宗北方法王殿位于密宗驻地北侧，依山而建，殿前是一片青石铺成的广场，广场边缘立着几根雕刻着密宗咒文的石柱。
大殿门楣上悬挂着一块暗红色的匾额，上面用梵文写着“北方法王殿”五个字。
殿内陈设简朴，正中是一尊大日如来的铜像，铜像前放着一只铜炉，炉中檀香袅袅。铜像下方，丹增盘膝坐在一方暗红色的蒲团上，面容枯槁，眼窝深陷，穿着一件暗红色的袈裟。
他左手握着一根白骨法杖，右手结印放在膝上，周身气息阴冷如蛇，周身数丈范围内的烛火都不受控制地微微偏向一侧。
content_en:
Du Mingfeng and Guo He stood in the hall for a moment, looked at each other, and then dispersed.
At the same time, Nanzhou Demon City and Blackwater Hall.
The door of the palace was open, and the sunset slanted in from outside the door, shining on everyone's faces.
Duan Zhengchun was sitting on the steps, holding a cup of spiritual tea in his hand, but without drinking it, his eyes fell outside the palace door.
Yang Zhenshan sat on his seat, folding his hands on his chest and closing his eyes, as if he was taking a nap or thinking about something.
Ghost Hand Qi also sat on the wooden chair at the side of the hall, without any expression.
He Zhou leaned on the pillar and looked outside quietly.
Honggu squatted in the corner, not looking at anyone or speaking.
The hall was quiet for a while, and Duan Zhengchun finally spoke, his voice neither high nor low: "It's been half a year, and there's been no news from the young master."
Yang Zhenshan replied with one word: "Yes."
Guishou didn't speak.
He Zhou glanced at Duan Zhengchun: "Are you talking about him?"
Duan Zhengchun did not answer.
"There has been no news for half a year." Duan Zhengchun repeated this sentence and swallowed it again, "Jiao Xuan was searched for three days and then withdrew. The four continents all agreed that he was dead."
Yang Zhenshan opened his eyes and said, "Do you believe it?"
Duan Zhengchun did not answer immediately.
Hong Gu's voice came from the corner, neither high nor low: "Whether he is dead or not, what does it have to do with us? Anyway, if he is dead, we can't turn around."
She paused, "We can't turn around even if he's alive."
Duan Zhengchun did not refute.
Guishou Qi's voice came from the corner, neither high nor low: "If he dies, can we still sit here alive?"
After his words fell, the palace was quiet for a moment.
Duan Zhengchun knew what Guishou Qi meant - the essence and blood are still there, the life is still there, and the five of them are still alive, which means that person is still alive.
Because the essence and blood are tied to the life and death of the master, if the master dies, the essence and blood will lose its sensitivity.
All five of them are still alive, which means that person is not dead yet, at least not completely fallen.
He Zhou took over: "He's not dead, but he may be trapped, or he may be seriously injured and recovering."
No one answered.
Yang Zhenshan's voice came, a little lower than before: "Whether he is dead or not is up to us. But one thing is certain - he has not come back, and the lives of us are much more stable than when he was here."
Honggu raised her head, as if those words had reached her heart: "Yes, he is not here, no one cares about us, and no one wants us to work hard. In the past six months, we have lived the most stable life."
Duan Zhengchun said: "Whether he comes back or not, it has nothing to do with us. If he really doesn't come back, we will stay in the Demon City because we have nowhere to go. If he comes back, we will see what he needs us to do."
Yang Zhenshan did not speak again.
He Zhou didn't speak anymore, as if nothing had happened.
Hong Gu lowered her head again, and the words she just said seemed to fall into everyone's hearts.
——
At the same time, in the northwest of Xizhou, the Tantric Northern Fawang Hall is located on the north side of the Tantric station and is built against the mountain. In front of the hall is a square paved with bluestones. On the edge of the square are several stone pillars engraved with Tantric incantations.
There is a dark red plaque hanging on the lintel of the main hall, with the words "Northern King's Hall" written in Sanskrit on it.
The furnishings in the hall are simple, with a bronze statue of the Great Sun Tathagata in the center. There is a copper stove in front of the statue, with sandalwood incense curling up in the stove. Under the bronze statue, Tenzin sat cross-legged on a dark red futon, with a haggard face and sunken eye sockets, and was wearing a dark red cassock.
He held a white bone staff in his left hand, and put his right hand on his knee in a seal. The aura around him was as cold as a snake, and the candlelight within a few feet of him was slightly tilted to one side uncontrollably.
